actual_failure_basis.shape: Exactly status=rejected and a string reason reporting the schematic netclass_flag support refusal.
actual_failure_basis.interpretation: Supports displaying the retained refusal reason. It is an intended unsupported Improve preview, not a failed Native Route or permission to admit that task.

source_review: Only exact integer exit2 at preview selects the new diagnostic. Nonzero outcomes still raise before records/ready/choice adoption.

Existing source/settings freshness precedes diagnostics; cancellation requests, signal exits and truncated logs skip diagnostic parsing. CliJob live cancellation and the finished callback retain later-cancel precedence.

Existing bounded strict read_json rejects aliases, oversized input, duplicate keys and nonfinite constants. The new helper requires exactly status/reason and status=rejected; malformed/positive/conflicting shapes fall back to generic refusal.

Untrusted reason display uses the existing 512-character printable sanitizer and points to the full retained log. No diagnostic value becomes a command, project path, accepted receipt or workflow state.

The GUI refusal callback clears prior ready/records/choice state and does not open a project. Seven new test methods cover these presentation seams using constructed controls; their success was not asserted by this reviewer.
limits: Source and retained-log review only. No new GUI observation, cancellation execution, Native qualification or test-pass claim.
